visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short brown hair and sunglasses wearing a white t-shirt sits in the passenger seat of a green-accented speedboat cockpit, gesturing and talking. (2) The boat speeds across open water under a bright sky, creating white spray as the man laughs enthusiastically. (3) The man and a young woman with long dark hair in a black top stand against a textured concrete wall, talking to the camera. (4) The woman leads two small children along a white wooden marina pier past luxury yachts. (5) The woman and children climb into a pink car-shaped speedboat docked at the pier. (6) A group photo shows the man, woman, two kids, and an older man and woman sitting in the boat with the Kaohsiung Music Center in the background. (7) The pink boat labeled '野粉公主' performs high-speed maneuvers on the water, tilting sharply. (8) Inside the boat, the driver in a pink shirt steers while the two young boys express fear and excitement. (9) One boy buries his head in his father's lap, looking distressed while the father comforts him. (10) The older man in a grey polo shirt smiles and talks inside the red interior of the boat. (11) The family walks back down the pier after the ride, with one boy looking disgruntled.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright digital 'ding' sound accompanies a woman saying 'I want to change husbands' in a high-pitched, playful tone, followed by a man's deep laugh. Upbeat, fast-tempo electronic music with a strong rhythmic beat begins. (2) Heavy engine roaring and rushing water splashing sounds dominate the mix as a man's voice yells 'No problem!' and laughs heartily amidst high-arousal screaming sound effects. (3) Acoustic shift to a calmer dialogue between a man and woman discussing a price of '7,800' with clear vocal articulation and moderate energy. (4) Sound of a group cheering 'Hey!' together in unison, followed by a shift in BGM to a bouncy, comedic track. (5) Sustained engine revving and sharp splashing transients as the boat speeds, accompanied by a woman's excited exclamation and several high-pitched child screams. (6) A child's distressed whimpering and crying sound is heard, followed by a father's calm, low-pitched consoling words. (7) A hard cut to an older man's laughter and a conversation about timing and money, with a final celebratory 'Zan la!' (Great!) and 'Kaixin' (Happy) from the woman.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family's humorous and slightly chaotic experience on a car-shaped speedboat in Kaohsiung. It uses the contrast between the high price of the ride, the excitement of the adults, and the fearful reactions of the children to create a comedic lifestyle vlog. The inclusion of the 'Kekjia' (Hakka) frugal spirit joke adds a layer of cultural humor.
